definition.def: If you are convinced that something is true, you feel sure that it is true.
examples: He was convinced that I was part of the problem.
He became convinced of the need for cheap editions of good quality writing. [+ of]

definition.def: If someone or something convinces you of something, they make you believe that it is true or that it exists.
examples: I soon convinced the jury of my innocence. [VERB noun + of]
It is difficult to convince the public of the need for change. [VERB noun that]

definition.def: If someone or something convinces you to do something, they persuade you to do it. [mainly US]
examples: In January, he convinced her to join him in the Pyrenees. [VERB noun to-infinitive]
